verdict.rationale: Productboard is a SaaS product with built-in AI features, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions a training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any data-usage policy for AI models. The workspace MCP enable toggle and role controls govern agent access, not model training, so they are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
